The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Library Board of
Trustees on any item of interest that is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Board of
Trustees. Pursuant to state law, the Library Board of Trustees may not discuss or take
action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Chair
reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up
on such items.

MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES
  MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 25, 2023 AT 8:00 A.M.
  BARTH ROOM, CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY

CALL TO ORDER: Chairperson Domier called the regular meeting to order at 8:06 a.m. in the
Barth Room, located at 1890 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Chairperson Domier led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL:  PRESENT: Alternate Wahl, Trustee Osegueda, Vice Chairperson Sadun,
  Chairperson Domier

  ABSENT: Alternate Wu, Trustee Chien, Trustee Derry

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

CEREMONIAL

1. REORGANIZATION OF THE LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES BY SELECTING
  A CHAIRPERSON AND VICE CHAIRPERSON

Vice Chairperson Sadun moved, seconded by Trustee Osegueda, to nominate Steve Domier for
Chairperson.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Alternate Wahl, Trustee Osegueda, Vice Chairperson Sadun, Chairperson Domier
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Alternate Wu, Trustee Chien, Trustee Derry

Trustee Osegueda moved, seconded by Alternate Wahl, to nominate Debra Sadun for Vice
Chairperson.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Alternate Wahl, Trustee Osegueda, Vice Chairperson Sadun, Chairperson Domier
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Alternate Wu, Trustee Chien, Trustee Derry

SEPTEMBER 25, 2023  PAGE 2 OF 4

BOARD OF TRUSTEES REPORTS

2. CHAIRPERSON REPORT

Chairperson Domier welcomed everyone back after having no meeting in August and thanked
everyone for their participation. He shared that he attended the Foundation’s donor appreciation
event on August 11 and shared how thrilled he is that San Marino continues to support the Library
despite the news about libraries and librarians under attack. He reminded everyone about the San
Marino Community Center VIP tours and grand opening. He also shared that the Board should
consider changing their liaison assignments at the next meeting for the upcoming year.

3. TRUSTEE REPORTS

Trustee Osegueda shared about the first collaboration project between the Crowell Public Library
and the Carver Library in which City staff worked to get a set of books to loan to the school library
for projects.

Alternate Wahl and Vice Chairperson Sadun did not have anything to report.

4. CRAIN ART GALLERY LIAISON REPORT

Vice Chairperson Sadun shared that Pete Morris sold 3 paintings and over 50 participants attended
the opening reception. She shared that the current exhibit displays the City’s photo contest entries
through the end of October, and will be followed by Emily Suñez’s watercolors. She explained that
for 2024, the Committee has only discussed the request from the Foundation to reserve the Gallery
during their event.

5. FRIENDS OF THE CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY LIAISON REPORT
Trustee Derry was not in attendance, so Library Manager Vera shared that the Friends have not
met as they traditionally do not meet in the summer.

6. SAN MARINO PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION LIAISON REPORT
Trustee Chien was not in attendance, so Director Johnson shared that City Manager Eskandar
attended the last meeting and the Foundation members expressed both concerns and appreciations
about Library operations.

NEW BUSINESS

7. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

Vice Chairperson Sadun moved, seconded by Trustee Osegueda, to approve the minutes of the

8. DIRECTOR AND LIBRARY MANAGER REPORT

Director Johnson and Library Manager Vera presented the staff report.

Vice Chairperson Sadun shared how thrilled she is to have the Facilities Supervisor, about the
addition of the part-time Mandarin speaking Library Assistant, and about the synergy between the
Library and the Community Center.

Trustee Osegueda recommended that staff consider advertising the Library’s social media handles
on the Foundation bookmarks.

Chairperson Domier shared that the Community Services Guide is crucial in getting the word out,
and that he appreciates how staff implemented feedback from the Board into the Guide.

Alternate Wahl shared that her daughter joined the TAG program and that she will report back on
what her daughter gets to do as a member.

The following person(s) provided comment:
